answer.areThe80PassesTheParcelsTheWalkBelievesI: NO, not for the swept cohort.
why: The sweep selects its ids from landing_cad_property (the CAD ACCOUNT namespace, payload->>'prop_id'): 15 of its 52 ids have no parcel-map row at all, and those 15 plus the gold are the walk's 16 failures.

Where a swept account prop_id also exists in txgio_parcel it can be a DIFFERENT parcel. Of the three passing ids sampled, the served card equals the parcel-map row exactly in all three (3/3), matches the account row the sweep keyed on for 1 of 3 (161090, which agrees with itself), and CONTRADICTS it for 2 of 3: 135541 serves 355 SMITH CREEK RD, WIMBERLEY 78678 against the swept row's 185 CIBOLO CREEK DR, KYLE 78640; 135695 serves 693 TRANQUILITY MTN, BUDA 78610 against the swept row's 511 CIBOLO CREEK DR, KYLE 78640.

landing_cad_property holds MORE THAN ONE row per prop_id for these ids with DIFFERENT situs (e.g. 135541: the tax_year-2025 'tier:stratmap-roll' row says 355 SMITH CREEK RD, WIMBERLEY while the 2026-preliminary-data-export-files row says 185 CIBOLO CREEK DR, KYLE), so the sweep's street key can be satisfied by one vintage while the parcel map and the serve carry the other.
answer.consequenceForThisLane: The 16 failing rows (grade BP-MEANING-01, reason 'HTTP 404') are exactly the nodes the parcel map does not hold -- 15 of them swept neighbours, plus the gold anchor. They are exactly the population P-180's earned retirement describes, and exactly the rows P-301 now grades RECORD_RETIRED when the store holds the retirement (measured: it holds it for all 16 -- see the store-retirement artifact). The 80 passes are map parcels, but not necessarily the parcels the sweep's account rows name.
answer.serveSideCorroboration: The walk's own serve discloses the account/parcel split, so this is not only a SQL reading: the 200 card for 48209:135541 carries provenance.situsAddressSupersededClaim = '185 CIBOLO CREEK DR, KYLE, TX 78640' with situsCitySupersededClaim 'KYLE' / situsZipSupersededClaim '78640' -- i.e. the very KYLE 78640 account claim the sweep selected on -- against baseFacts.situsAddress '355 SMITH CREEK RD, WIMBERLEY, TX 78678-5561', and provenance.parcelJoin.basis states the join is joined-own-prop-id: 'this row is the node's, not the account's, so no collision can produce it'. Both fields are captured verbatim in the serving-probe artifact.
answer.notFixedHere: P-301 is scoped to the walk recognising the serve's declined-retirement body. The sweep's identity/vintage basis (account prop_id vs parcel-map prop_id, and two disagreeing landing vintages per id) is P-178's question and is reported to the operator rather than changed.
